cases.root_cause: Duration-based pharmacy authorization mismatch; the claim exceeded the allowed days-supply policy for the selected drug.
cases.resolution_used: Validated the payer duration rule, confirmed NDC and days-supply mapping, and routed the claim to the pharmacy exception queue for manual review.
recommended_actions: Validate days-supply against the plan policy.
Check whether the NDC/drug authorization rule was applied correctly.
Escalate the case to pharmacy adjudication for exception review.
cases.impact: Medication dispensation was delayed and the claim had to be resubmitted or manually reviewed.

cases.root_cause: Policy-rule mismatch in pharmacy adjudication caused the duration rejection despite otherwise stable pricing and dispensing values.
cases.resolution_used: Reviewed the prior authorization and payer policy for refill duration; approved after a manual pharmacy exception review.
recommended_actions: Confirm the health-plan duration rules for refill exceptions.
cases.impact: Delay in dispensing and additional operational review burden.

cases.root_cause: The claim profile was valid clinically but outside the payer’s days-supply threshold and thus required manual review.
cases.resolution_used: Checked the utilization policy, matched the claim to the active authorization, and approved under a duration exception workflow.
recommended_actions: Validate whether the authorization was correctly linked to the NDC.
Check policy thresholds for extended days supply.
Route to exception review when standard adjudication fails.
cases.impact: Discharge or fill was delayed until policy exception review was completed.
